name: godesk
description: Turn a script or idea into a playable, shareable game. Friends join from a URL.

interface.shortDescription: Write an idea, get a joinable game
interface.longDescription: Install GoDesk in Codex or open the website, upload a script, rulebook, or written idea, and receive a playable Shared Session. Other people join through a URL and play together. They do not install Codex.
defaultPrompt: Create a playable game from this idea
Open my GoDesk project and start a joinable session
Share this game so a friend can play in the browser
